lines: 宇宙星空，冰冷浩瀚。
这是一片古老巍峨浩瀚到无法想象的区域。
一座传送阵静静盘坐于此，已经不知道存在了多少岁月。
这时，这传送阵之上骤然传来一阵剧烈的空间能量波动。
轰！
一道高大挺拔的黑袍身影从中缓缓踏出！
此人，正是叶无缺！
他，在征服了四大宇宙之后，依次探索了那四合宇，五合宇，以及六合宇，而后还去往了道神主路的后段。
这段时间，他的修为境界暴涨，战力水涨船高，已经深不可测。
尤其是在那道神主路的后段，天骄争霸精彩纷呈，热血沸腾。
叶无缺在其中逆天崛起，横扫无敌，镇压一切，成为了名震寰宇的黑袍战神，恐怖威势震慑无远弗届。
结束道神主路的后段后，他踏上了一座极有可能直接传送到九天十地的空间传送阵，经过足足半个月的长时间传送，此刻终于从传送阵之中踏出。
叶无缺看向前方，映入眼帘的是一片古老，巍峨，璀璨，浩瀚到无法想象的宏伟星空。
他缓缓吐出了一口浊气。
眼底出现了一抹淡淡的激动和期待之色。
“九天十地……叶某来了……”
叶无缺一步踏出，就要往前方而去的时候。
突然，异变陡生！
叶无缺身形四周的虚空中，骤然之间有炽烈的光芒爆闪，三个方向，三柄缭绕着恐怖骇然气息的匕首，骤然之间从原地爆发，以难以想象的速度朝叶无缺悍然袭来！
快！
无法想象的快！
似乎根本来不及抵挡！
这三柄匕首朝叶无缺悍然袭来的同时，不远处的虚空中，传来几道满是贪婪、戏谑和嗜血的冷笑和嘲讽之音。
果然有肥羊啊！”
“这一趟收获真是不小啊！
守了这么久，终于等到了！”
“哈哈哈哈！
看这小子这样子，连护体光辉都没有！
估计又是一个初来乍到的雏儿！
宰了他，我们三兄弟又能够在君大人那里领赏了！
这次估计又能逍遥几百年了！”
“太好了！
天降横财！
动手！”
他们的身形缓缓从虚空中显化而出，看着叶无缺的方向，满脸戏谑。
然而，很快，他们脸上的戏谑之色全部凝固了！
content_en:
The starry sky in the universe is cold and vast.
This is an ancient, majestic and vast area that is unimaginable.
A teleportation array sits here quietly, having existed for who knows how many years.
At this time, a violent fluctuation of space energy suddenly came from the teleportation array.
boom!
A tall and straight figure in black robe slowly stepped out!
This person is none other than Ye Wuque!
After conquering the four universes, he explored the Siheyu, Wuheyu, and Liuheyu in sequence, and then went to the back section of the Taoist Main Road.
During this period, his cultivation realm has skyrocketed, and his combat power has soared to the point where it is unfathomable.
Especially in the latter part of the Divine Main Road, the battle between geniuses was exciting and exciting.
Among them, Ye Wuque rose against the will of heaven, swept invincible, suppressed everything, and became the world-famous black-robed God of War, whose terrifying power shocked people far and wide.
After completing the latter part of the Taoist Main Road, he stepped onto a space teleportation array that was very likely to be directly teleported to the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. After half a month of long teleportation, he finally stepped out of the teleportation array.
Ye Wuque looked forward, and what he saw was an ancient, majestic, bright, and unimaginably vast starry sky.
He slowly exhaled a breath.
There was a hint of excitement and anticipation in his eyes.
"Nine Heavens and Ten Earths...Ye is here..."
Ye Wuque took one step forward and was about to go forward.
Suddenly, a sudden change occurred!
In the void around Ye Wuque's figure, there was a sudden burst of blazing light. From three directions, three daggers filled with terrifying auras suddenly erupted from the spot and attacked Ye Wuque at an unimaginable speed!
quick!
Unimaginably fast!
It seems there is no time to resist!
While these three daggers were attacking Ye Wuque brazenly, several sneers and mocking voices full of greed, teasing and bloodthirsty came from the void not far away.
"Hey!
Sure enough, there are fat sheep! "
“The harvest from this trip is really big!
After waiting for so long, the wait is finally here! "
“Hahahaha!
Look at this kid like this, he doesn't even have the brilliance to protect his body!
Probably another new arrival!
After killing him, we three brothers can receive the reward from Lord Jun again!
This time it is estimated that I can live happily for hundreds of years! "
"Great!
Windfall!
Do it! "
Their figures slowly emerged from the void, looking in the direction of Ye Wuque, with faces full of teasing.
However, soon, all the joking expressions on their faces froze!
